likelihood.observations: raw unrebinned integer detector counts per channel
likelihood.line_shape: unit-normalized Gaussian plus unit-normalized left-exGaussian charge-loss mixture, integrated over calibrated bin edges
likelihood.resolution: declared per-table form; Table 3 canonical sigma_keV = sqrt(intercept_keV^2 + variance_slope_keV * nominal_line_energy_keV)
likelihood.background: declared interval-nonnegative Bernstein affine or quadratic counts/s/keV density evaluated at calibrated bin centers, with a free common background-scale nuisance for each run after the first; quadratic endpoint coefficients are nonnegative while the middle coefficient may be negative subject to the exact cone middle + sqrt(low*high) >= 0
likelihood.multi_run_signal: Table 3 canonical phase-2 fit has one nonnegative detected full-peak rate for every run and component; the former shared origin-class scaling model is retained only as a restrictive comparison
likelihood.calibration: common offset and fractional-gain-stretch nuisances with declared Gaussian constraints; Table 8 additionally declares one zero-centered domain-normalized quadratic-curvature nuisance after coherent antisymmetric centroid residuals; Table 3 additionally declares zero-centered per-run offset/stretch deviations and relative resolution-scale nuisances for runs after the reference run
likelihood.optimization: stable per-bin Poisson NLL relative to saturation; scaled L-BFGS-B warm solve with deterministic box-constrained SLSQP polish when required; quadratic backgrounds use a relaxed middle coefficient followed by an exact interval-nonnegative cone postcheck and transformed constrained fallback on violation; success requires the declared scaled projected-gradient stationarity gate
likelihood.canonical_intervals: Full Fisher covariance for regular interior fits; 95% profile likelihood where implemented for weak/boundary ratios, using tight stable-difference SLSQP, exact quadratic-cone coordinates, explicit inner-solver/KKT gates, and a frozen fitted-NLL versus tight-profile-base consistency check; deterministic parametric bootstrap remains a coverage diagnostic; model-variant RMS covariance is kept separate
likelihood.fisher_covariance: Expected Fisher rank, condition, and inversion are evaluated in declared scaled-parameter coordinates; the inverse is transformed back to physical coordinates before extracting yield covariance
likelihood.information_criteria: Any AIC/BIC-shaped arithmetic is labeled nonstandard penalized-objective descriptive arithmetic because the objective includes Gaussian constraint penalties; it is not used for model promotion
likelihood.coverage_diagnostic: deterministic joint parametric bootstrap of raw-bin Poisson counts and every Gaussian constraint pseudo-observation; each Gaussian pseudo-observation is independently drawn from N(fitted generating nuisances, declared covariance) and used as the constraint center for that replica; diagnostic only

sum_first_local_workflow.accumulation: nonnegative integer channels added in int64 after exact run, calibration-group, A0/A1, energy-grid, and width-grid equality checks; no interpolation or rebinning

sum_first_local_workflow.model_selection_rule: Use one family for every primary window. Prefer the smaller identifiable family unless the added nuisance is interior, coherent residual morphology improves across multiple windows, and reported rows remain stable. Never select by row p-value. A bound-active tail or nonrecurrent improvement is sensitivity only. Local deviance is diagnostic, not a publication gate.
sum_first_local_workflow.per_window_sensitivity_rule: Refit every primary window independently on identical bins with free effective width and the canonical background/shape. Cross-window numerator/reference covariance is zero for disjoint Poisson bins; same-window fitted covariance is retained. Flag when absolute ratio movement exceeds the canonical conditional 1 sigma.

sum_first_local_workflow.weak_branch_rule: Frozen isotope set only: Pb-214/Bi-214, Pb-212/Bi-212/Tl-208/Ac-228, Cd-113 capture, H-1, Ar-41, Cu-63/Pb-207 capture, and catalogued intrinsic Ge activation. Only same-isotope lines within 25 keV in one window are even eligible for an intensity constraint, and none is constrained without RD-geometry evidence that cascade summing cancels. Therefore free catalog amplitudes are background flexibility, never an explained prediction; cross-energy prediction is unavailable without a response/geometry model.
sum_first_local_workflow.unidentified_nuisance_rule: Promotion requires an interior yield at least 2 conditional Fisher sigma in each of the three 86400-s files, maximum absolute fitted target/nuisance correlation below 0.95, and target-ratio movement below one canonical conditional sigma. Otherwise retain unidentified diagnostic status only.

drift_diagnostic.centroid_threshold: coherent same-sign multi-anchor inter-file spread greater than min(0.5 native channel, 0.5 local fitted sigma)
drift_diagnostic.high_energy_limitation: Per-file anchors end at 2614.511 keV. Any drift verdict for sparse lines above 5 MeV is conditional on affine gain drift; extrapolation beyond the anchor range cannot exclude higher-order calibration drift.
drift_diagnostic.invalidation: all three conditions required: centroid threshold, predicted quadrature mixture sigma increase above 5%, and material accumulated ratio movement above one canonical conditional sigma

sum_first_local_workflow.row_classification_rule: Supported quantitative requires successful full-rank/interior fit, reference supported, interval excluding zero, no material local residual morphology, and no greater-than-one-sigma per-window movement. Boundary yields are never quantitative. Zero-compatible weak yields receive a one-sided limit or unavailable status. Other statuses are visible/identified but quantitative area unreliable; broad physical feature requiring a non-Gaussian template; unresolved blend; unsupported/unavailable.
sum_first_local_workflow.reference_rule: The 558.456-keV row must pass the same quantitative rule. Its self-ratio is exactly one with exactly zero variance. If it fails, qualify every ratio.

table3.simultaneous_fit_reason: All four files share the exact database calibration, detector, orientation, shield, and run family. Counts are not combined. The canonical phase-2 likelihood estimates every run/component yield independently while retaining shared calibration, resolution, line-shape, background-shape, and nuisance covariance.
table3.heterogeneity_boundary_policy: Rate GLS excludes a run when that component yield is on a fitted bound; ratio GLS excludes a run when either numerator or denominator yield is on a fitted bound. Excluded runs remain in per-run and exposure-summed descriptive products. A diagnostic is unavailable, not negative, when fewer than two interior runs remain.

ratio_stability.material_threshold: max(1.0 canonical conditional Fisher SD, 0.05*abs(canonical ratio))
ratio_stability.statistical_floor_annotation: If movement exceeds 1.0 Fisher SD but passes only through the 5% floor, retain per-row driver, SD units, and relative units.
ratio_stability.declared_variants: every successful full-rank shape, background, neighbor, and role-local sensitivity on identical native bins

status_codes.Q: supported quantitative: target yields interior and identifiable; full-rank covariance; no unresolved blend or target-core residual; all material movements within threshold
status_codes.V: quantitative but explicitly model-sensitive: identifiable ratio with a physically plausible movement above threshold, tail-choice status change, or mandatory Al-27/Ge-70 DEP sensitivity
status_codes.R: visible component but quantitative ratio unreliable because target-core morphology, covariance/shape identifiability, or role-specific response mismatch defeats area use
status_codes.X: unresolved blend: target-target or target-nuisance absolute correlation at least 0.95, or equal-status Al-27/Ge-70 reallocation above threshold
status_codes.B: boundary or one-sided upper limit from a valid 95% likelihood profile
status_codes.U: unsupported/unavailable: failed fit/profile, absent component, nonpositive denominator, or no defensible estimator

local_workflow.profile_rule: Profile every ratio having a target numerator or denominator below 3 conditional Fisher sigma or on an active yield bound. A boundary numerator gets an upper limit; a nonpositive or boundary denominator, or failed profile, is unavailable. Regular interior ratios use full J Sigma J-transpose covariance.
local_workflow.bootstrap_rule: No local bootstrap coverage claim: fewer than 200 replicas cannot change a reporting action. Existing 12-replica phase-2 reproduction remains a deterministic plumbing diagnostic.
local_workflow.role_separation_rule: No free per-role or per-line centroid shifts and no higher-order calibration. Re-measure role-dependent residual centroids by group; persistent FEP/SEP/DEP separation is response/background evidence, not calibration freedom.
local_workflow.cluster_identifiability_rule: Report Fisher rank, scaled condition, and target-pair line-rate correlations for 7631.180/7645.580 in DEP, SEP, and FEP. Absolute target-target correlation at least 0.95 forces X for ratios involving that target/role.
local_workflow.model_selection_rule: One family for all groups; no row-wise model selection, cross-domain deviance ranking, physical-constraint relaxation, residual peak discovery, or post-hoc isotope assignment. Local deviance and residuals diagnose status but are not blanket vetoes.

table8.contaminant_policy: Phase 2 tests only catalogued lines from materials documented or physically plausible in the detector assembly. Canonical Fe-54 and Cu-63 additions have source plausibility and residual support. The close Al-27/Ge-70 6.71-MeV alternatives directly reallocate a target DEP and are retained at equal noncanonical sensitivity status despite their likelihood difference. Residual-only automatic peak discovery is prohibited.
